# Thanh Bình Nguyễn — Personal Hub

> Personal site of Nguyễn Thị Thanh Bình (Thanh Bình) — geoscientist & subsurface engineer, innovation practitioner, musician, and video creator. A cinematic, multi-world personal hub documenting how ideas begin and take shape, across engineering, innovation, and music.

## Pages
- [Home](https://binh-jx.github.io/thanhbinh-hub/index.html): Entry cinematic and overview, with links into every world on the site.
- [Innovation Journey](https://binh-jx.github.io/thanhbinh-hub/innovation.html): A gallery of how ideas begin — geopressure energy recovery, self-healing materials, and biomass-derived critical minerals.
- [Music & MV World](https://binh-jx.github.io/thanhbinh-hub/music.html): Music and music-video work.
